messages:
Lina (CS): Kicking off Voxera Therapeutics onboarding. Aim: pilot their drug-info assistant across 4 workflows (clinical Q&A, safety triage, internal search, report summarization). Need owners, measurable success criteria, timeline, and any compliance blockers. Suggested 45m kickoff this week. Intake: https://redwood.app/onboard/VX-912 :seedling; Mateo (Solutions): +1. Quick ask: will they provide PHI-masked data or synthetic? That affects Private vs Hosted decision.; Anya (Voxera AM): Hey all 00% they will provide de-identified CSV + a small labeled JSONL set. Security team requested an initial data-handling note. I'm available Friday 910:30 CT.; Victor (Voxera Eng): I'll be the eng lead. We prefer a S3 drop with manifest. Can provide schema and 150 labeled examples by Wed. Also will need a test API key and CORS allowed origin.; Sasha (Security): Heads up: our baseline for regulated pilots is VPC + KMS if any de-id is reversible. If it's truly de-identified CSV we're ok on Hosted for the pilot, but we need the data-handling note before keys are issued. Legal will also want DPIA notes.; Lina (CS): Proposed 4-week timeline (flexible):

Week A: Kickoff, data agreement sign, access setup
Week B: Ingest + smoke tests (auth, logs, routing)
Week C: Pilot run + labeled eval + fix loop
Week D: Handover + enablement + go/no-go decision

Priya (Enablement): I'll schedule training in Week D. Plan: 30m live demo + 15m Q&A, plus a 1-pager and a short runbook. Want to know target users (ops vs researchers) to tailor content.; Anya (Voxera AM): Primary users will be clinical ops + a small researcher group (3 power users). So Ops-first training please.; Mateo (Solutions): Draft success criteria to consider:
- Latency: 95th < 600ms for short Q&A (50-150 tokens)
- Quality: Top-1 accuracy >= 80% on curated eval set; top-3 recall >= 92%
- Safety: zero high-severity hallucinations on the test corpus
- Observability: events + token breakdown visible in Console
- Cost: avg token cost < $0.003 per txn
Agree?; Victor (Voxera Eng): Those look fine. Add: end-to-end throughput 100 rps sustained for a 10m soak without >1% 5xx.; Sasha (Security): Add a timeline risk: legal/SLA + data processing addendum may take 12 business days. Mitigation: temp scoped keys + IP allowlist + short-lived creds for pilot.; Ben (Legal-bot): Noted. I'll attach the DPA template and flag accelerated review request. @Ben (Legal-bot) uploaded: https://files.redwood/legal/DPA-Voxera-draft.pdf; deploy-bot: Provisioned temporary API key vx-pilot-temp-xxx (expires in 14 days) and created allowlist entry for 52.23.11.77.; Lina (CS): Nice. Action items I have: 1) calendar invite for Fri 9 CT (Anya confirmed) 2) Anya/Victor to upload schema + 150 examples by Wed EOD 3) Security to confirm data-handling note + temp keys (Sasha) 4) Priya to prep Week D training draft 5) Mateo to publish eval template. I'll post a shared checklist after this thread. Anything missing? :memo:; Anya (Voxera AM): All set from Voxera side. I'll upload the samples Wed and ping here. Thanks team. :pray:; Victor (Voxera Eng): Upload scheduled. One small ask: can Solutions/SE share a latency script or harness? Mateo (Solutions): Yep, I'll drop a simple load script and a quick cost calc by tomorrow.
